description: Updates the configuration of an agent.

researchLinks.description: We Found Eight Attack Vectors Inside AWS Bedrock. Here's What Attackers Can Do with Them

securityImplications: Attackers might use UpdateAgent to rewrite a Bedrock agent's base prompt so it leaks its internal instructions and tool schemas, or to redirect it to attacker-controlled behavior.

simulation.value: aws bedrock-agent update-agent --agent-id TrailDiscover --agent-name TrailDiscover --agent-resource-role-arn arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/TrailDiscover --foundation-model anthropic.claude-v2
